column1: # Shared vectors for the git/lang data-request JSON builder: op, escaped cwd,
# format, the __gpy_json_flags_tail tail, and -- for `lang` only -- the
# forwarded virtualenv. Read by all three implementations so the request bytes
# Which virtualenv is forwarded is pinned separately by
# venv_forwarding_vectors.tsv; here only $VIRTUAL_ENV is set (CONDA_* unset).
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated:
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The whole-column token \e
# means the EMPTY string. The input columns use the mini escape scheme of
# \r -> CR, \t -> tab). `expected` is literal -- the builder's output with no
# trailing newline. Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields
